sources.fullCitation: Bibliothèque nationale de France, notice de personne “Steinhof, Ninon”, pseudonyme, forme internationale, FRBNF14700943, ark:/12148/cb14700943p. Female, writing in French and translating from German, described as a translator. The BnF gives the dates as “Naissance : 18..?” and “Mort : 19..”, that is a nineteenth-century birth and a twentieth-century death, neither year established. “Steinhoff, Ninon” is recorded as a rejected form. The notice cites two sources: the printed music “Adieu”, music by Pierre Candel, words by Ninon Steinhoff and André Legrand, 1934 — the same sheet held in this archive — and the French adaptation of Ferdinand Bruckner's play “Les criminels”, made with André Mauprey in 1950. ISNI 0000 0001 1982 6820. Sixteen bibliographic records are linked to her as author. Accessed 2 August 2026.
